entities.title: Hedgerow Godot client
entities.summary: The game in Godot 4.7 (GDScript, Compatibility renderer for WebGL 2): map, 3D diorama, procedural pieces, rules, computer opponent, camera and HUD, all built in code without imported assets.
entities.purpose: Everything the player sees and plays. main.gd runs the turns; the other scripts each own one part, as the component diagram shows. Run with -- --autotest it plays a whole game computer against computer at high speed and quits, which is the game's test (npm run test:godot).
boundaries: Talks to nothing: no server API, no storage. The Worker only serves it.
web_shell/ is the page template for the export and is left out of the pack.
